nodes.label: בר האיכות — the four-rule quality bar for every solution
nodes.rationale: Set 2026-06-11 after the owner's recurring complaint that explanations were too dense, skipped steps, and were not bagrut-focused. Every solution must satisfy all four: zero step-skipping, the topic-defining step highlighted, bagrut focus, and one $$...$$ line per step.

nodes.label: Gold-standard topic: math5/complex-numbers.ts
nodes.rationale: Rather than describing the bar abstractly, the guide names a concrete reference implementation (base + advanced complex-numbers paths) that every new topic must mimic in structure, tone and depth.

nodes.label: LearningPath 8-section structure (fixed order)
nodes.rationale: prerequisites → intuition → concepts → guidedExamples → pitfalls → practice → formulaSheet → comprehensionCheck. The TypeScript type in types.ts makes every section mandatory, so a missing section is a compile error rather than a silent content gap.

nodes.label: Zero step-skipping (אפס קפיצות)
nodes.rationale: Every computational step must be visible: (3+i)(2+i) shows 6+3i+2i+i², then the i²=−1 substitution, then 5+5i. A sentence that assumes knowledge not previously explained in the path fails the guide.

nodes.label: Atoms, not blocks (7 small concepts beat 3 big ones)
nodes.rationale: Each concept atom runs plain → formal → simplestExample → whyItWorks/diagrams. If an atom needs two separate ideas, split it. No formula is 'thrown in': formal always justifies or demonstrates it, or whyItWorks gives an analogy.

nodes.label: methodChoice — knowing WHEN to pick a method
nodes.rationale: Method selection is the actual missing skill — students know how to execute a method but not when to choose it, so every guided example opens with methodChoice and every step carries a `why` (the reasoning a student internalizes), not just an `action`.

nodes.label: Progressive hint reveal + reviewIfStuck linkage
nodes.rationale: Hints go from gentle ('which quadrant is the point in?') to nearly-the-answer, revealed one at a time. Every reviewIfStuck.conceptId must match an existing ConceptAtom.id in the same path so the link scrolls to the right atom.

nodes.label: keyPoints ("לזכור") = triggers and traps, not formula repetition
nodes.rationale: Decided with the owner 2026-07-28 after Vieta's theorem appeared three times on one screen. The learn screen already shows each step's formula card plus the formulas section, so a keyPoint restating a formula 3cm above it is noise. Each bullet must answer one of: when does this fire, what does it save, what is the trap. 3-5 bullets, Hebrew prose, almost no $...$. Separately, LearnLevel auto-filters formulas already taught in a step, so formulas[] can stay complete for the global drawer without duplicating on screen.

nodes.label: MCQ authoring: write the correct answer first (correct: 0)
nodes.rationale: Most readable in source, and the display layer already shuffles options deterministically by question id (lib/shuffle.ts → seededOrder), so the student never sees the correct answer in a fixed slot. Manually 'spreading' the correct position is redundant and harmful.

nodes.label: Always double backslashes in LaTeX source strings
nodes.rationale: In JS strings a single backslash is swallowed as an escape, so \\sqrt / \\dfrac / \\text{cis} are required — including inside template literals.

nodes.label: Complex numbers: cis and degrees only, never e^{iθ} or radians
nodes.rationale: Mandated by the 5-unit syllabus: write 45°, 90°, 180°, 360° rather than π/4. Every result must also be hand-checked before saving — a single sign error burns the student's trust.

nodes.label: No Hebrew inside math (learned in analytic geometry, 2026-06-10)
nodes.rationale: KaTeX performs no bidi, so \text{מרכז} or m_{משיק} render reversed ('זכרמ') plus console warnings. Hebrew labels go outside $...$ and subscripts use Latin letters ($m_r$).

nodes.label: Bidi fixed at the rendering layer (2026-07-28) — no more content workarounds
nodes.rationale: The old rules ('never end a Hebrew sentence with $math$.', 'never open a line with a formula') existed because neutral punctuation flipped against math islands. The cause was removed: MathText now returns one element with dir="rtl" in both modes and every .katex is unicode-bidi:isolate, so a neutral run between two RTL sides resolves RTL per UAX#9 rule N1 — browser-verified. What remains forbidden is $$...$$ mid-prose-line, because remark-math hoists display math into its own block and orphans the following text; verify:content enforces it.

nodes.label: MathText contract as stated in the style guide (one element, flex rule)
nodes.rationale: Both modes return one element (<span> inline, <div> block), which is what stops a display:flex container from decomposing a sentence into separate flex items — the bug that rendered the 'לזכור' box as three columns. A flex row containing MathText puts chat-md on an inner <div className="chat-md flex-1 min-w-0">, never on the flex container, because all .chat-md rules are descendant combinators.

nodes.label: Diagram rules: DiagramSpec, custom raw SVG only, no fn: closures
nodes.rationale: A functionGraph closure crosses the server→client boundary and 500s the page in production, so curves must be drawn as static SVG. The SVG is inner content only (no wrapping <svg> tag), default viewBox 0 0 200 200, and captions pass through KaTeX so $...$ is allowed inside them.

nodes.label: Adding a new learning path (4-step procedure)
nodes.rationale: Create math5/<topic>.ts exporting a LearningPath, register it in index.ts under 'math5:<Hebrew topic name>' where the key must be byte-identical to the existing Lesson's topic so links resolve, then build/commit/push. The 'מסלול לימוד מ-0' banner then appears automatically on the existing topic page.

nodes.label: Bagrut focus + Hebrew male-form, no decorative emoji
nodes.rationale: Content must say where a technique appears in the exam, which shortcut saves time, and what the grader wants to see — no textbook expansions beyond the exam. Hebrew is male-form (the owner identified as male), and no decorative emoji inside content since headings and components already carry icons.
